integrity: The complete 90-facet complex is embedded. Integral H2 is reconstructed by two unimodular chain reductions, every four-vertex support is exhausted, all 153 surviving carriers are proved nonzero and primitive, and the integral-to-mod-two spectrum is checked exactly.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns minimum vertex support in one fixed twelve-vertex labelled triangulation. The displayed Z^4 basis is computational rather than intersection-form canonical, and the result does not classify larger supports or the two different vertex-transitive twelve-vertex triangulations of the same manifold.
title: Complementary mod-two planes govern shortest \(H_2\)-carriers in a twelve-vertex \((S^2\times S^2)\#(S^2\times S^2)\)
